verdict.rationale: Phoenix explicitly supports scoring live traces & spans with LLM-judge, code-based, or human evaluators (docs-39) and can collect production traffic into datasets (docs-25), suggesting evaluation isn't limited to static offline datasets. However, most evaluator workflow documentation (evaluators attached to datasets, experiments comparing runs, dataset evaluators as 'unit tests') describes a batch/experiment-centric pattern rather than a continuous, automated pipeline running on live streaming traffic, so it's unclear if evaluation runs automatically/continuously versus being manually triggered on captured traces.
